definitions.full: H8473. tachra תַּחְרָא noun [masculine] probably (linen) corselet ( ᵑ7 Onk שריון ); — absolute ׳ת Exod 28:32 , || 39:23 (P), in simile. [ תַּחֲרָה ] see חרה . תַּחֲרֵעַ see חרע .
